topic: Minimum design wind load, other structures (walls, hoardings, signs)
summary: The design wind force on other structures must not be less than 0.8 kN/m2 times the projected area Af. For a solid hoarding this governs mid-wall whenever qh G Cf is below 0.8 kPa (KAC: 0.665 calculated -> 0.8 used). Apply to every zone, including case C zones that fall below 0.8.
No reduction in velocity pressure is allowed for the apparent shielding of nearby buildings, other structures or terrain.
Take V from 26.5, Kd from 26.6, exposure from 26.7, Kzt from 26.8 and enclosure from 26.10.

Kz or Kh from 29.3.1 (CR) by exposure category; qz from 29.3.2 (CR). Use the numerical constant 0.613 unless climatic data justify another value (29-3-2-2). Our formula: qh = 0.613 Kz Kzt Kd V^2 (N/m2, V in m/s); this edition follows the ASCE 7-10 layout and has no ground elevation factor Ke.

topic: Solid freestanding walls and solid signs
summary: Design wind load per Section 29.4.1 of the English SBC 301-CR (force coefficient Cf figure, cases A, B, C). The Arabic AR edition does not print the Cf table; check the CR figure notes before applying the (1.8 - s/h) reduction to cases A and B.

A sign fixed to a building wall (face parallel to and in contact with the wall, not past its sides or top) is designed with the chapter 30 wall pressures and GCpi = 0. Also applies to signs not in contact with the wall when the gap is at most 1 m and the sign edge is at least 1 m from the free edges of the wall.

V is taken from the wind map per 26.5.1.1 (map in SBC 301-CR, not printed in the AR edition), except as in 26.5.2 and 26.5.3. Wind may act from any horizontal direction. Increase V where records or experience show higher speeds (26.5.1.3). Riyadh used by Samaya: 45 m/s (confirmed by the user on DAS and KAC, Nov 2026); Risk Category I value not yet checked in the CR map.

topic: Wind speed from local climate data
summary: Local data may replace the map only with approved extreme-value statistics and allowance for record length, sampling error, averaging time, anemometer height, data quality and terrain. A lower V than the map is allowed (26.5.3.2) but not lower than the speed for the required return period, adjusted to a 3 s gust at 10 m in exposure C.
Kd per 26.6.1 (CR), used only with the load combinations of 2.3 and 2.4. Samaya uses Kd = 0.85 for solid freestanding walls and signs.

B: urban and suburban areas, wooded areas, many closely spaced obstructions the size of houses or larger. C: open terrain with scattered obstructions generally under 10 m, flat open country, grassland. D: flat unobstructed areas and water surfaces, smooth mud flats, salt flats.

Exposure B: roughness B prevails upwind for more than 450 m (mean roof height up to 9 m), or more than 780 m or 20 times the height, whichever is greater (height over 9 m). Exposure D: roughness D upwind for more than 1500 m or 20h, and also downwind of D within 180 m or 20h. Exposure C: all other cases. Between categories use the higher-load category unless a recognised intermediate method is used. Hoardings inside Riyadh (KAC, DAS): exposure B.

Chapter 27 directional and chapter 28 envelope procedures for buildings; chapter 29 for appurtenances and other structures (walls, signs, tanks, open frames, towers) with the exposure giving the highest load for any wind direction; chapter 30 for components and cladding.

Speed-up over isolated hills, ridges and escarpments must be included when all five conditions hold (isolated, unobstructed upwind for 100H or 3 km, protrudes above upwind terrain by factor 2 within 3 km radius, site in the upper half near the crest, H/Lh >= 0.2, H >= 5 m in C and D or 18 m in B). If the conditions are not met, Kzt = 1 (26-8-2-2).

G may be taken as 0.85 for rigid buildings and other structures (26-9-1, 26-9-4). Flexible or dynamically sensitive structures per 26.9.5. Approximate natural frequency methods allowed for buildings up to 90 m tall and shorter than 4 times their effective length.

Glazing protection applies within 1.6 km of the coastal mean high water line where V >= 58 m/s, or anywhere V >= 63 m/s (Risk Category II and III except health care; Risk Category III health care and IV use Figure 26.2-B).
Strength design combinations in 2-3, allowable stress design in 2-4. Samaya hoarding checks use LRFD: 1.4D, 1.2D + 1.0W, 0.9D + 1.0W (uplift and overturning), and D + 0.6W for serviceability.

SBC 301-AR-18 states the requirements in Arabic and points to the English SBC 301-CR section numbers for maps, figures and tables. It follows the ASCE 7-10 chapter layout (26.9 gust effects, 26.10 enclosure). For values from figures (wind map, Cf, Kz tables) use the CR edition.
